name: StoreAgent – WooCommerce MCP & WooCommerce AI Chatbot
author: Josh Kohlbach

sections.description:
🟡 WooCommerce MCP, WooCommerce Chatbot and WooCommerce AI Content Tools

StoreAgent brings WooCommerce AI to your store in three ways: a WooCommerce MCP server that connects ChatGPT or Claude to your store, a WooCommerce chatbot that answers shopper questions 24/7, and a set of AI content tools that write product descriptions, tags, alt text and review summaries. All of it runs on your real product catalogue — titles, descriptions, attributes, variations, prices and reviews — so your assistant and the chatbot work from what you actually sell.

None of it is a generic ChatGPT window bolted onto your sidebar. The WooCommerce MCP server, the chatbot and the content tools all work from your own store data, so they know your stock, your prices and your policies.

  • 🔌 WooCommerce MCP – Connect ChatGPT or Claude to your store so your own AI assistant can work with your products, orders, content and chat data
  • 💬 WooCommerce Chatbot – An AI chatbot for WooCommerce that instantly answers shopper questions from your own product data
  • ✍️ AI Product Description Writer – Create SEO-ready copy in seconds
  • 🏷️ AI Product Tag Generator – Suggests optimised product tags
  • ⭐ AI Review Summaries – Turns reviews into powerful social proof
  • 📈 AI Insights Dashboard – See what the chatbot is doing and where your content needs work
  • ⚡ No-Code Setup – Connect your store and the chatbot starts working, no API keys to hunt down

👉 You’ll need a free StoreAgent.ai account to activate the AI features.

🧠 Why Store Owners Choose StoreAgent

✅ Bring the AI Assistant You Already Use

With WooCommerce MCP, ChatGPT or Claude can look up your products, orders and chatbot conversations and, where you allow it, do the work for you. You approve the connection from your own wp-admin and choose exactly which abilities it can use.

✅ Slash Your First-Response Support Times

Turn your store chat into a WooCommerce chatbot that handles FAQs, product questions and order questions — the bulk of everyday customer support — saving you hours every week.

The StoreAgent WooCommerce AI chatbot slashes first-response times to under 10 seconds and cuts repetitive support questions by 70% or more. Your team stops answering the same five questions over and over, because a conversational chatbot trained on your product data answers them first.

✅ Ship SEO-Ready Product Pages In Seconds

AI product description generation is included for all accounts, even free plans. Answer a couple of questions about your product and watch as our e-commerce trained AI writes the copy in a flash.

✅ Insights Delivered To Your Dashboard

StoreAgent actively surfaces content improvement opportunities and delivers them to your dashboard, then it’s one click to run the AI content tools and implement the change. The ultimate balance between staying in control and letting AI do the hard work.

✅ No More Copy+Paste Or Fiddling With API Keys

Most AI tools feel like you’re babysitting a chat prompt — StoreAgent is different. If you’re still copying and pasting out of a ChatGPT window you’re missing out on e-commerce AI agents that are trained and tuned for store owners. And there are no provider API keys to dig for: connect your store and get started.

🤝 1. WooCommerce MCP – Connect ChatGPT and Claude To WooCommerce

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard that ChatGPT and Claude use to connect to outside tools. StoreAgent includes a WooCommerce MCP server, so the AI assistant you already use can work directly with your store. Add your store as a custom connector in ChatGPT or Claude, approve the connection from your own wp-admin, and the assistant can read your store data and, where you allow it, take action for you. Read-only abilities are on by default, anything that makes changes stays off until you switch it on, and a 30-day activity log shows everything a connected assistant did. WooCommerce MCP is included on every plan, including free.

Some things store owners do with WooCommerce MCP:

🤖 Ask how many orders came in this week, and how that compares with last week
🤖 Ask which orders have been paid but not shipped yet, so you can clear them before the day ends
🤖 Ask which products are low on stock or sold out, and get a restock list back
🤖 Ask Claude to write a description for a product that is missing one, then review it before it goes live
🤖 Ask ChatGPT which products have no tags or no upsells and cross-sells, and have it fill the gaps
🤖 Get a summary of a product’s reviews without leaving your assistant
🤖 Read through recent chatbot conversations and pull out the questions shoppers keep asking
🤖 Check whether your AI memory has finished indexing after a big catalogue import

For order and stock questions, WooCommerce MCP uses WooCommerce’s own abilities, which ship with WooCommerce 10.9 and later, so your assistant works with live store data rather than a copy.

🧩 WooCommerce MCP Works With Your Other Plugins Too

WordPress and WooCommerce plugin developers are adding AI abilities to their plugins through the WordPress Abilities API, and new ones arrive every week. StoreAgent’s WooCommerce MCP server picks up every ability registered on your site automatically, with no extra setup or add-on. Install or update a plugin that ships abilities, and ChatGPT or Claude can use them straight away. The same permission rules apply to every ability, whichever plugin it comes from.

💬 2. WooCommerce Chatbot – AI Chatbot for WooCommerce

A WooCommerce AI chatbot trained on your own products, live on your storefront in minutes. Here is what it does:

🟢 AI Chatbot Widget – A real-time conversational chatbot on your storefront, powered by your own product data
🟢 Product-Aware Conversations – Answers pulled directly from titles, specs, attributes, variations and reviews
🟢 Live Price & Stock Answers – The chatbot reads live product and variation prices at the moment it answers, so it never quotes a stale figure
🟢 Order Lookups – Signed-in shoppers can ask the chatbot about their own orders
🟢 In-Chat Coupon Offers – Let the chatbot offer a coupon to move a hesitant shopper over the line
🟢 Competitor Blocklist – Name the brands you never want your chatbot to mention or recommend
🟢 Tone Control – Set the tone of voice your chatbot replies in
🟢 Multi-Language Detection – The chatbot answers each shopper in their own language
🟢 Full Chat History Logs (Paid Plans) – Read every conversation your chatbot has, in your StoreAgent.ai account
🟢 Feedback & Human Escalation – Shoppers rate the chatbot’s answers, and unresolved conversations can be emailed to you as a summary with the customer set as reply-to
🟢 Guest & Logged-In Support – The chatbot works for anonymous visitors, not just account holders
🟢 WooCommerce Integration – Works out of the box with WooCommerce and any WooCommerce-compatible theme

🛒 A WooCommerce Chatbot That Actually Knows Your Store

Most WordPress chatbot plugins ask you to paste content in by hand or point them at a sitemap. StoreAgent indexes your store properly.

Choose which post types feed the chatbot — products, posts, pages, or any combination — and StoreAgent keeps that index in sync as you publish and edit. You can exclude specific pages, watch indexing progress as a live percentage, and re-sync any post type on demand. The chatbot holds off appearing on your storefront until the first index finishes, so a shopper never meets a chatbot that doesn’t know anything yet.

Variable products are handled properly, right down to per-variation pricing, which is where a lot of AI chatbots quietly fall over on a real WooCommerce catalogue.

🎨 Customise Your WooCommerce Chatbot to Match Your Brand

Your chatbot should look like it belongs on your site.

  • Set the widget colours, text and greeting to match your brand
  • Choose the chatbot’s position on screen, or open it by default
  • Drop the chatbot inline anywhere with a shortcode instead of a floating bubble
  • Control which post types and pages the chatbot appears on
  • Preview mode to test chatbot answers before your shoppers see them

📊 See What Your Chatbot Is Actually Doing

The StoreAgent dashboard tracks chatbot impressions, conversations and chat → add-to-cart events, and turns them into a KPI band and a conversion funnel. You get a plain-English briefing you can open as a full report or share with your team, so the chatbot stops being a black box.

✍️ 3. AI Content Tools for WooCommerce

Every plan includes a working set of AI agents for the content jobs you keep putting off:

✍️ Product Descriptions – SEO-friendly product copy in seconds
✍️ Category Descriptions – SEO-friendly copy for your category archives
⚡ Short Descriptions – Scroll-stopping blurbs auto-generated from your long copy
🏷️ Product Tags – One-click tag suggestions for better on-site search
⭐ Review Summaries – Turns mountains of reviews into punchy social proof
🖼️ Image Alt Tags – Accessible, descriptive alt text generated from the image itself
🎟️ Coupon Descriptions – Readable coupon copy written for you
🤝 Upsell & Cross-Sell Suggestions – AI-recommended product pairings
🛡️ Review Moderation – An AI agent that triages incoming product reviews for you
❓ Product Questions (Q&A) – Answer shopper questions on the product page, with an Ask a Question widget

Run any agent on a single product, on a sample, or in bulk across your whole catalogue — from the products list, or from WP-CLI. “Complete this product with AI” runs several agents at once to fill out a thin product in one click, and every agent shows its credit cost before you spend anything.

📈 AI Insights for WooCommerce

🔔 Automated Notifications – StoreAgent surfaces quick fixes to your dashboard so you can improve listings without going looking for problems
📈 Content Quality Monitoring – Watches description length and quality, with one-click buttons to fix what it flags

🔌 Works With Your Existing Stack

StoreAgent integrates with WooCommerce Wholesale Suite (and respects your wholesale role conditions), WC Vendors, and SiteGround Optimizer. It also exposes 30 abilities through the WordPress Abilities API, so other AI tools on your site, and any assistant connected through WooCommerce MCP, can call StoreAgent’s agents directly.

🌍 Built for WordPress & WooCommerce

  • Install and connect your store in a few minutes
  • Compatible with any WooCommerce-ready theme, including block themes
  • Lightweight, CDN-served assets and GDPR-compliant

🆓 Get Started for Free

The free Lite plan gives you a real taste of everything, including WooCommerce MCP, the WooCommerce chatbot and the content tools. Keep it as long as you like. Upgrade when you want higher plan limits or the more advanced features.

See all plans at storeagent.ai/pricing/.

Use of Third-Party Services

This plugin connects your store to the StoreAgent.ai service to power the AI chatbot and the AI content tools. A free StoreAgent.ai account is required.

When enabled, the plugin sends the content you select for indexing (for example product titles, descriptions, attributes, prices and reviews) and the messages shoppers type into the chatbot to StoreAgent.ai, which generates the responses and content and returns them to your site.

  • Service: StoreAgent.ai
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

When you deactivate the plugin, a short “Quick Feedback” form asks why you are leaving. It is sent to StoreAgent.ai only when you choose Submit & Deactivate. Choosing Skip & Deactivate, closing the form with Escape, or clicking outside it sends nothing at all, and nothing is sent before you choose Submit. When you do submit, the form sends the reason you picked, anything you typed in the comment box, your site address, your plan, and version details for the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce. Your email address is included only if you tick “You can email me about this.”

Please make sure this is compatible with your own privacy policy and applicable data protection laws before enabling the chatbot on a live store.

Feedback and Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature suggestions, please reach out to us at support@storeagent.ai.

Have an idea for an AI tool? Let us know.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file (if installing manually).
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to StoreAgent > Settings to connect your StoreAgent.ai account and switch on the chatbot and the AI agents you want.
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreAgent.ai account?

Yes, an active StoreAgent.ai account is required — the free plan is enough to run everything in this plugin. Sign up here.

Is this a free WooCommerce AI chatbot plugin?

Yes. StoreAgent.ai has a free plan with generous inclusions, including the AI chatbot, WooCommerce MCP and the AI content tools. You can run it on your store without paying anything.

Do I need an OpenAI or other provider API key?

No. There are no provider API keys to find, paste or pay for. Your StoreAgent.ai account handles the AI, so everything works as soon as your store is connected.

What is the chatbot trained on?

Your own content. Point StoreAgent at your products, posts and pages and it indexes them, including product titles, descriptions, attributes, variations, prices and reviews. You choose what goes in and what stays out.

How long does it take before the chatbot can answer questions?

Indexing starts as soon as you finish setup, and you can watch it as a live percentage. The widget deliberately holds off appearing on your storefront until the first index completes, so shoppers never meet an assistant that has nothing to work with.

Can the chatbot see live prices and stock?

Yes. Rather than relying only on the indexed copy of your catalogue, it reads live product and variation prices at the moment it answers, so it doesn’t quote a price you changed last week.

Does the chatbot handle variable products?

Yes, including per-variation pricing. This is a common failure point for AI assistants on real WooCommerce catalogues, so it is handled explicitly.

Can the chatbot answer questions about a customer’s order?

Yes. It can look up order data for the signed-in customer asking about it.

Can the chatbot offer a discount?

Yes. You can let it offer a coupon during a conversation to help a hesitant shopper commit.

Can I stop the chatbot mentioning my competitors?

Yes. You can maintain a per-site blocklist of brands, and it will never name or recommend them.

Can I control the chatbot’s tone of voice?

Yes. Set the tone you want and it replies in that voice, so it sounds like your brand rather than a generic assistant.

Does the chatbot speak other languages?

Yes. It detects the language a shopper writes in and answers in that language, and you can also set a global language for the store.

Where does the chatbot appear on my site?

Wherever you want it. Show it as a floating widget, choose its screen position, have it open by default, exclude specific pages, limit it to certain post types, or place it inline anywhere using the shortcode.

Can I customise how the chatbot looks?

Yes. Colours, greeting, button text and position are all configurable from the settings, and there’s a preview mode so you can test answers and styling before shoppers see them.

Can I read the conversations my chatbot is having?

Yes. Full chat history is available on paid plans, in your StoreAgent.ai account, and it’s one of the best sources of content ideas you’ll find — real questions, in your customers’ words.

What happens when the chatbot can’t answer?

Shoppers can rate its answers, and unresolved conversations can be emailed to you as a summary with the customer set as reply-to, so you can pick the conversation up personally.

Does the chatbot work for visitors who aren’t logged in?

Yes. It works for guests as well as logged-in customers.

Can I see whether the chatbot is actually making me money?

The dashboard tracks impressions, conversations and chat → add-to-cart events, and presents them as KPIs and a conversion funnel, plus a briefing you can open as a full report or share with your team.

Does StoreAgent work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes. StoreAgent is compatible with all WooCommerce-compliant themes, including block themes.

Will the chatbot slow my store down?

The frontend assets are lightweight and CDN-served, and the AI itself runs on StoreAgent.ai rather than on your server, so it isn’t competing with WooCommerce for PHP or database resources.

Is StoreAgent GDPR-compliant?

The plugin is built to be GDPR-compliant. Because conversations and content are processed by StoreAgent.ai, please review the third-party services section above and your own privacy policy before enabling it on a live store.

Can I run the AI content tools in bulk?

Yes. Run any agent on one product, on a sample first, or in bulk across your catalogue from the products list or via WP-CLI. Every agent shows its credit cost before you commit.

What else does StoreAgent do besides the chatbot?

A WooCommerce MCP server for ChatGPT and Claude, plus a full set of AI agents for product descriptions, category descriptions, short descriptions, product tags, review summaries, image alt tags, coupon descriptions, upsell and cross-sell suggestions, review moderation and product Q&A — plus an insights dashboard that tells you which listings need work.

What is WooCommerce MCP?

WooCommerce MCP connects an AI assistant such as ChatGPT or Claude to your WooCommerce store through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Once connected, the assistant can read your products, orders, content and chatbot conversations, and take the actions you allow. StoreAgent includes a WooCommerce MCP server on every plan, including free.

Can I connect ChatGPT or Claude to my WooCommerce store?

Yes. StoreAgent includes a WooCommerce MCP server on every plan, including free. Turn on MCP under StoreAgent > Settings > MCP, add your store as a custom connector in ChatGPT or Claude, and approve the connection from your wp-admin. Read-only abilities work straight away; abilities that make changes stay off until you allow them.

Does StoreAgent integrate with other plugins?

Yes — WooCommerce Wholesale Suite (respecting your wholesale role conditions), WC Vendors, and SiteGround Optimizer. StoreAgent also exposes 30 abilities via the WordPress Abilities API so other AI tools on your site can use its agents.

Can the chatbot handle customer support questions?

Yes — deflecting repetitive customer support is what most stores use it for. It answers product, shipping, policy and order questions straight from your own content, so your team only sees the ones that genuinely need a person. Anything it can’t resolve can be emailed to you as a conversation summary with the customer set as reply-to.

Is this an AI shopping assistant as well as a support chatbot?

Both. Because it is trained on your catalogue, it works as an AI shopping assistant — helping shoppers compare products, check price and stock, and find the right item — as well as an AI assistant for everyday customer support questions.

How is this different from other AI chatbot plugins?

Most AI chatbot plugins are general-purpose: you hand them a sitemap and hope. StoreAgent is built specifically for WooCommerce, so it understands products, variations, live prices, orders and coupons — and the same plugin also writes your product content and connects ChatGPT or Claude to your store through WooCommerce MCP. No prompt babysitting, no copying between tools.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Feature: A scheduled check now finds published products with no tags and sends you a notification — click Accept to generate and save the tags with the Product Tags Generator AI
  • Improvement: The Connection tab now shows when an annual plan renews and when its usage resets
  • Improvement: General security and privacy hardening
  • Bug Fix: Annual plans unlocked only the free-tier chat settings instead of their paid features
  • Bug Fix: Lite plans show their lifetime allocation on the Connection tab again
  • Bug Fix: Permanently deleting a product now always removes it from AI Memory

1.2.0

  • Feature: Topic-based chat escalation — billing, refund and cancellation conversations are handed to a human automatically
  • Feature: Upload your own avatar image for the AI Chat assistant
  • Feature: Alt text is now generated automatically for new product images
  • Feature: WordPress privacy tools for chat data — a suggested privacy policy snippet, chat data in Tools > Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data, and deleting a shopper’s chat transcripts on request
  • Feature: A new Privacy setting lets you turn off order lookups in the chat, and order lookups now send less personal data to StoreAgent
  • Feature: New MCP abilities let a connected AI assistant list, view, dismiss and act on StoreAgent notifications
  • Feature: New MCP abilities let a connected AI assistant get a chat feedback summary and export chat conversations
  • Feature: A short “Quick Feedback” form now asks why you’re deactivating StoreAgent, with an option to skip and deactivate straight away
  • Improvement: The MCP abilities browser now lists StoreAgent’s built-in abilities with a locked switch and a tooltip that explains why they can’t be turned off
  • Improvement: The MCP abilities list now shows 20 abilities per page
  • Improvement: After a settings sync, the MCP settings tab shows what was actually published to your connected AI assistants
  • Improvement: MCP ability listings now tell AI assistants whether an ability reaches outside your store and whether it is safe to repeat
  • Improvement: The “Metadata Keys to Include” setting for indexing custom fields is now easier to find
  • Improvement: AI Memory now indexes your configured custom and ACF fields from product variations
  • Improvement: AI Memory now re-syncs a product when one of its tracked custom or ACF fields changes, not only when the product is saved
  • Improvement: The weekly usage check-in now reports whether the AI Chat widget is enabled
  • Improvement: The usage check-in now reports where the plugin was installed from
  • Improvement: The weekly usage check-in now includes chat-attributed revenue and order count
  • Improvement: General security hardening
  • Bug Fix: AI Chat settings now save on sites whose options table can’t store emoji, such as the default greeting’s emoji
  • Bug Fix: Saving the chat widget settings no longer reports success when the save actually failed
  • Bug Fix: Branding colors now save when the color picker adds a transparency value
  • Bug Fix: Disconnecting your store now notifies StoreAgent correctly
  • Bug Fix: The weekly usage check-in no longer skips every second week

1.1.9

  • Feature: Connect your own AI assistant to your store with MCP — on any plan, including free. Link Claude or ChatGPT through a per-store connection you approve yourself, follow the built-in connect guide for your assistant, manage or revoke connections from the new MCP settings tab, and review a 30-day activity log of everything an assistant did.
  • Feature: Decide exactly what a connected assistant can do. The MCP Abilities browser lets you pick a source, filter by status or by whether an ability makes changes, search by name, and allow every read-only ability (or disable all of them) in one action. Read-only abilities are available by default, abilities that make changes stay off until you allow them, and you can hide any individual ability.
  • Feature: Conversation starters — write your own opening messages and set a delay, and the chat widget speaks first with a preview bubble and an unread badge.
  • Feature: The AI chatbot now reads live stock straight from your store — it can say whether a product is in or out of stock, how many are left, and whether it can be backordered, and the answer updates the moment you change stock without waiting for a re-index (your “Stock display format” setting is respected, so a store that hides quantities stays hidden)
  • Feature: Chat answers can now cite the store content they were drawn from
  • Improvement: Catalog indexing now runs continuously batch-to-batch instead of stalling until the next scheduled check, so your AI memory finishes syncing faster
  • Improvement: AI Memory uploads now stop retrying once your plan’s limit is reached and tell you to check your StoreAgent account, instead of retrying in the background forever
  • Improvement: The “indexing needs attention” notice now explains that indexing resumes by itself, so you know there’s nothing to fix
  • Improvement: The WordPress.org review request now waits for real success signals — your catalogue finished indexing and at least one AI response or chat reply went out — instead of a bare 14-day install timer, and re-asks up to twice more (60 days apart) if you don’t click through
  • Improvement: A dismissible “Enjoying StoreAgent?” notice on the StoreAgent dashboard surfaces the review ask so it’s actually seen
  • Improvement: The chatbot now knows whether a shopper is signed in and where your store’s login page is, so it can point a guest to the right page when they ask about a specific order
  • Improvement: Every upgrade link now points to the same plans page, and stores that can upgrade get an Upgrade link on the WordPress Plugins page
  • Bug Fix: Products hidden from your WooCommerce catalog are no longer indexed into AI Memory, so the chatbot can’t recommend them
  • Bug Fix: The AI chatbot no longer reports a stock count for products that are out of stock or on backorder (including a negative count on an oversold product), and no longer tells shoppers that grouped or external products cannot be purchased
  • Bug Fix: Chat transcripts could be read by anyone who learned a session ID — the chat now proves ownership of a session with a private token before it returns history
  • Bug Fix: Chat product lookups now prefer an exact name or SKU match and skip unpublished products, instead of returning one arbitrary match
  • Bug Fix: The Wholesale Suite integration now reports role-wide and category wholesale discounts in chat pricing, not just flat per-product wholesale prices
  • Bug Fix: The “Number of Product Features to Include” setting for the Product Summaries AI can now be set to 0, which leaves the feature list out of the summary
  • Bug Fix: AI memory sync no longer stays stuck below 100% after a plan upgrade — the upload watchdog restarts once the quota block clears
  • Bug Fix: A temporary hiccup checking your plan limit no longer gets mistaken for a finished catalog sync, so you won’t get a “setup complete” email while indexing is still in progress
  • Bug Fix: The “Set up StoreAgent Chat” notice no longer keeps showing once chat is enabled and your data is already indexed
  • Bug Fix: The AI Coupon Generator settings tab now loads its settings instead of failing to render
  • Bug Fix: The indexing error troubleshooting link now points at a live help article
  • Bug Fix: Chat widget impressions are now recorded for signed-in visitors, so the dashboard funnel counts them
  • Bug Fix: Deactivating or deleting StoreAgent now removes all of its scheduled background tasks, so nothing keeps running in the background — and re-activating restores the schedules your enabled features need
  • Bug Fix: Switching to the AI Chat settings tab from another settings tab now opens its General sub-tab instead of the sub-tab you last visited

Older releases are listed in changelog.txt in the plugin folder, and in the plugin’s full version history on WordPress.org.

When you deactivate the plugin, a short “Quick Feedback” form asks why you are leaving. It is sent to StoreAgent.ai only when you choose Submit & Deactivate. Choosing Skip & Deactivate, closing the form with Escape, or clicking outside it sends nothing at all, and nothing is sent before you choose Submit. When you do submit, the form sends the reason you picked, anything you typed in the comment box, your site address, your plan, and version details for the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce.
